QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also off (lines 2185 and 2196).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves the threading macros (THREADING_C, PTHREAD, ALT) off, so a default build defines none of them.
